key_insight: This work generalizes biologically-informed neural networks (BINNs) to 2D+t reaction–diffusion systems, preserving the known PDE diffusion operator while learning unknown reaction kinetics with trainable neural subnetworks enforced by PDE residual penalties.
problem_solved: Overcomes the limitation of prior BINN/PINN studies that were restricted to 1D+t systems, providing a framework to discover constitutive reaction terms and infer parameters from sparse/noisy 2D spatiotemporal biological data while respecting the underlying differential-operator structure.
method: Construct a BINN that hard-encodes the 2D diffusion operator and represents unknown reaction kinetics as small trainable neural subnetworks.
Train with a composite PINN loss: data-fitting + PDE residuals (soft enforcement) + boundary/initial condition penalties, evaluated over 2D+t collocation points.
Employ practical training strategies for 2D: multi-scale/spatial sampling, adaptive loss weighting and regularization to improve robustness to noise and limited observations.
impact: Enables data-driven discovery and parameter inference for complex spatiotemporal biological pattern formation from imaging or simulation data, bridging mechanistic PDE models and ML methods—useful for practitioners in scientific ML, computational biology, and model discovery.
visual_elements: Architecture diagram: 2D BINN showing fixed diffusion operator blocks + trainable reaction subnetworks and loss components (data + PDE residuals).
Sequence of 2D heatmaps (time slices): ground truth vs BINN reconstruction and learned reaction-field visualization.
Residual / error map over space-time and a plot of loss-term decomposition (data vs PDE residual) to show training dynamics.
Comparison schematic: limits of 1D+t methods vs richer pattern capture in 2D+t (e.g., stripes, spots, waves).
paper_title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Biological $2\mathrm{D}{+}t$ Reaction-Diffusion Systems
paper_authors: William Lavery, Jodie A. Cochrane, Christian Olesen, Dagim S. Tadele, John T. Nardini
